BiblicalUsage: tsᵉʻâdâh describes a march; an ankle-chain. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including 2 Samuel 5:24 and Isaiah 3:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉʻâdâh belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
